title: ColdStart
date_note: Date of the existing scope triage, not a claim of exhaustive literature-search coverage through this date.
status_note: Provisional literature comparison and review queue. No independent admissions or executed benchmark results yet.

scope.N0: A genuinely new retailer product with no own-sales history at forecast time.
scope.K: A genuinely new retailer product with all available history since first retailer-wide launch, at most 28 elapsed calendar days.
scope.history_clock: Calendar age from the first retailer-wide launch, not row count or first sale in another store.
scope.observed_zero_rule: Observed zero sales are history; missing sales and stockout censoring are separate.
scope.global_novelty: Not required; annotate separately when evidenced.

methods.name: XGBoost with metadata and horizon features
methods.scope_basis: Only the R01 attribute/covariate recipe and its origin-safe reproduction; remove unrelated M5 support.
strengths: A practical tabular starting point; the paper tests demand prediction for styles before their own sales exist.
limitations: Private fashion data; discount and visibility inputs need a forecast-time availability audit. No retail-wide superiority or dollar lift is established.

sources.title: Fashion Retail: Forecasting Demand for New Items

methods.name: LightGBM with metadata and horizon features
methods.scope_basis: Algorithm was tested on new styles in R01; no architecture-wide superiority claim.
strengths: The paper tests a tabular method using information about new styles.
limitations: A tested comparator in one private fashion study; its inclusion does not establish the best result or transfer to another retailer.

limitations: A tested comparator in one private fashion study; its inclusion does not establish the best result or transfer to another retailer.

methods.name: GTM-Transformer
strengths: Combines product images and attributes with category trends without needing the new product's sales.
limitations: Single fashion retailer; web signals must be available at the forecast date. Six-week results are not revenue evidence.

methods.name: POP auxiliary signal plus fixed forecaster
methods.scope_basis: Treat POP plus fixed forecaster as one pipeline and audit web signal vintage/cost.
strengths: Tests whether a web-image trend signal improves the same fixed new-product forecaster.
limitations: A signal-and-forecaster pipeline, not a standalone forecasting model. Historical web timestamps, collection cost and repeatability need audit.

methods.name: MuQAR
methods.scope_basis: VISUELLE unit-sales experiment qualifies; popularity/review/demographic-proxy tasks do not.
strengths: Combines visual and product attributes with category trends for the paper's new-garment unit-sales experiment.
limitations: Only the VISUELLE sales task qualifies; its review/popularity and demographic proxy tasks are excluded. Cross-paper training budgets may differ.

methods.name: MDiFF — original VISUELLE zero-history recipe
methods.scope_basis: Keep MDiFF and Dif4FF named variants; same family does not provide independent replication.
strengths: Generates several possible sales paths, then refines them into a point forecast for a product with no own sales.
limitations: Generating paths does not prove calibrated uncertainty. The same dataset and related authors do not provide independent replication.

methods.name: Dif4FF — original VISUELLE zero-history recipe
methods.scope_basis: Keep MDiFF and Dif4FF named variants; same family does not provide independent replication.
strengths: Combines generated sales paths with graph refinement for the original zero-history VISUELLE task.
limitations: Checkpoint selection and small text/table differences need audit. Missing stronger comparator results limit claims of superiority.

sources.locator: Experimental setup; Table 1; diffusion/refinement and ablation sections

methods.name: VISUELLE 2.0 image-conditioned RNN — initial two-week prefix only
methods.scope_basis: First two weeks predict subsequent ten; retailer-wide identity and launch-age audit required; later rolling windows excluded.
strengths: Directly studies the first two weeks of observed sales to predict the following ten weeks.
limitations: Reconcile first launch across all stores. Later rolling origins may exceed 28 days; stockout-free selection changes which products are represented.

methods.name: Myntra paper naive control — original new-style recipe
methods.scope_basis: Reproduce the actual new-item comparator, not a generic seasonal-history control.
strengths: Provides the original study's new-style comparison point for a faithful reproduction.
limitations: Reconstruct the original comparator from the paper. Do not substitute a seasonal method that needs the new item's unavailable sales history.

papers.title: Predicting demand for new products in fashion retailing using censored data
papers.recipe: Historical stockout reconstruction/EM substitution plus RF, DNN, SVR or distance-based new-product model
papers.read_depth: Publisher-indexed abstract and Sections 3-4, limitations; direct fetch blocked
papers.target_unit: Aggregate demand for a new collection product; not a daily forecast target
papers.horizon: Product exposure period; native duration varies, not a history prefix
strengths: Addresses the difference between sales and demand when older training products were out of stock.
limitations: First sale proxies exposure; zero-stock and zero-sales rule misses partial-day stockouts. Reconstructed demand is estimated, not observed ground truth.
